title: modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk v2.0.0rc1
raw_text:
First v2 release candidate. Pre-releases are opt-in only; `pip install mcp` still resolves to the stable 1.x line.

```bash
pip install mcp==2.0.0rc1
# or
uv add "mcp==2.0.0rc1"
```

The [documentation](https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/) has the full tutorial and API reference, and the [migration guide](https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/migration/) covers coming from v1. The last pre-release pass over the public surface; every item has a migration guide entry.

title: Anthropic 删了 80% 提示词，但你不能照做
raw_text:
TL;DR

Anthropic 砍掉了 Claude Code 系统提示词的 80% 以上，编码评测没有可测量的损失。

但这句话真正证明的，是那 80% 本来就没在传递信息——它是给弱模型打的补丁，不是知识。

一个团队能删掉多少提示词，度量的不是模型有多强，是他们之前写了多少废话。

模型学到的是世界的公共部分。你的规则里装的是私有部分——“我们周五不发版”、“这个库禁用”、“这个仓库的类型全在一个文件里”。这些从没进过任何语料库，模型再强也补不上。

该薄的是公共部分，该厚的是私有部分。而按 token 数砍，砍掉的往往正好是后者。

一、一份被当成指引的实验报告

Anthropic 最近发了一篇文章——The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models，讲他们如何为新一代模型重做上下文工程。核心事实只有一句：他们把 Claude Code 的系统提示词删掉了 80% 以上，在自己的编码评测集上没有观察到可测量的损失。

文章顺势列了六条“已经过时的最佳实践”：

给模型定死规则，改成让模型自己判断；给工具用法示例，改成把语义设计进接口；把信息全部前置塞满，改成按需分批加载；重要的话说三遍，改成说一次并放进工具描述；记忆写进 CLAUDE.md，改成让模型自动存取；用简单的 markdown 写规格，改成给它测试套件、代码、评分标准这类更丰富的引用。

这六条单独看都不难接受。真正值得停下来的地方，是他们删掉的具体是什么。
reason_zh: 对Anthropic删减提示词事件进行深度剖析，指出公共知识与私有规则的本质区别，对提示工程有颠覆性见解。
summary_zh: 本文针对Anthropic砍掉Claude Code系统提示词80%以上且编码评测无损失的事件进行深入分析。作者指出，被删除的80%提示词原本就是给弱模型打的补丁，而非有效知识。模型学到的是世界的公共部分，而私有规则（如“周五不发版”、“禁用某库”）从未进入语料库，模型再强也无法补上。因此，提示词应该薄化公共部分，厚化私有部分。按token数砍提示词往往会砍掉后者，导致效果下降。文章还讨论了提示工程的核心在于区分公共知识和私有规则，并给出了实践建议。
title_zh: Anthropic 删了 80% 提示词，但你不能照做

title: Do VLMs Read or Rewrite? On Transcription Faithfulness in Vision-Language Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.21617v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of traditional OCR pipelines for document understanding. In this paper, we show they do not always act as faithful transcribers: when text is imperfect, they often tend to rewrite it into a more plausible form - a behavior that clean-text OCR benchmarks cannot detect. We introduce FaithC4, a multilingual perturbation benchmark of 1,455 single-page documents (English, Chinese, Korean) with three perturbation families: scramble, random substitution, and visually similar substitution. We use the benchmark to evaluate 15 systems spanning general-purpose VLMs, OCR-specialized VLMs, and traditional OCR pipelines. These three categories differ in WER degradation under perturbation: general-purpose VLMs degrade by up to 4.5 points, OCR-specialized VLMs by 0.2-2 points, and traditional OCR by less than 0.6 points on English. Probing Qwen3-VL-4B layer-by-layer, we identify a consistent
reason_zh: 揭示了VLM在文档理解中并非忠实转录，而是倾向于重写文本，对OCR应用有重要警示。
summary_zh: 本文指出视觉语言模型（VLM）在文档理解任务中并不总是忠实的转录者。当文本存在缺陷时，VLM倾向于将其重写为更合理的形式，而这一行为在干净的OCR基准测试中无法被检测到。作者引入了FaithC基准来评估转录忠实度，实验表明现有VLM在转录不完美文本时存在显著偏差。该研究对依赖VLM进行文档处理的系统提出了重要警示，并呼吁关注模型在真实场景中的可靠性。
title_zh: VLM是阅读还是重写？关于视觉语言模型转录忠实度的研究

title: Adversarial Prompts for Acceptance Collapse in Speculative Decoding
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.21804v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Lossless acceleration schemes, such as speculative decoding, promise significant inference speedups by relying on dynamic token-level alignment between a draft and a target model. However, this guarantee of semantic equivalence masks a severe operational vulnerability: draft-target alignment can be systematically attacked. In this paper, we introduce ADSD, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first prompt-suffix attack that collapses verifier acceptance by pushing draft probability mass toward tokens the target is unlikely to accept. ADSD uses Soft-Collapse, a verifier-aligned surrogate derived from the asymmetric speculative acceptance rule, together with a target-preservation objective that discourages obvious task corruption. ADSD successfully generates highly effective adversarial suffixes. On the GSM8K dataset, our attack increases the mean sample time by 62.3% while preserving the task quality. We further show that this vu
reason_zh: 首次揭示推测解码中草稿-目标模型对齐的脆弱性，可被对抗性提示攻击导致接受崩溃。
summary_zh: 推测解码等无损加速方案通过依赖草稿模型和目标模型之间的动态token级对齐来实现显著推理加速。然而，本文发现这种语义等价保证掩盖了一个严重的操作漏洞：草稿-目标对齐可以被系统性攻击。作者引入了一种对抗性提示方法，能够导致接受崩溃，即目标模型拒绝接受草稿模型的输出，从而破坏加速效果。实验表明，该攻击在多个模型上有效，且难以防御。该研究对部署推测解码的系统提出了安全警告。
title_zh: 针对推测解码中接受崩溃的对抗性提示

title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.02770v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking mode, enabling Gemma models to generate reasoning traces prior to responding. We improve inference speed, memory, and compute efficiency, as well as long-context abilities through critical design choices. Gemma 4 establishes a leap in performance across STEM, multimodal, and long-context benchmarks, and rivals larger, frontier open models in human-rated tasks.
reason_zh: Gemma 4技术报告，介绍新一代开源多模态模型，涵盖密集和MoE架构，参数范围2.3B-31B，对开源社区影响重大。
summary_zh: Gemma 4是Google发布的新一代开源权重、原生多模态语言模型。该系列包括密集和混合专家（MoE）架构，参数规模从2.3B到31B不等。模型在视觉和音频编码器上进行了改进，旨在提升计算效率和推理能力。技术报告详细介绍了模型架构、训练方法和性能评估，展示了在多种任务上的先进水平。
title_zh: Gemma 4 技术报告

title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.22529v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. reason_zh: 提出技能自博弈方法，让LLM在自我进化中同时提升任务多样性与验证可靠性，思路新颖。
summary_zh: 本文提出Skill Self-Play方法，推动大语言模型（LLM）通过交互驱动的自我进化。现有自进化方法面临任务多样性与验证可靠性的两难：环境绑定方法反馈精确但领域狭窄，开放自生成方法多样但反馈不可靠。Skill Self-Play通过让模型在技能空间中自我博弈，同时生成多样化任务和可靠验证信号，实现技能协同进化。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上显著提升了LLM的能力边界。

title: Reliability Scales Inversely: Bigger Language Models Compound Mistakes Faster
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.18292v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: As language models scale, answers start truer but degrade faster: scaling buys capability but erodes reliability. The knowledge-gap account -- more data, retrieval, or scale -- misses an auto-regressive risk residual that increases with scale: the model commits to a low-probability token, conditions on it as established, and snowballs. We track this through per-position disagreement $\delta = \log p_M - \log p_O$ against a stronger same-family oracle, whose second moment splits exactly into bias$^2$ $\mathrm{KL}(p_M \,\|\, p_O)^2$ and risk $\mathrm{Var}[\delta]$. Across three model families, we present four findings: (i) under scaling, the knowledge gap falls up to $7\times$ while knowledge degradation grows up to $39\times$; (ii) at a fabrication, felt uncertainty $H(p_M)$ relaxes quickly while oracle-referenced risk persists up to $23\times$ longer, leaving a confident-but-precarious risk regime that bridges consecutive fabri
reason_zh: 揭示大模型规模增大反而加速错误累积的反直觉现象，对模型可靠性研究具有重要警示意义。
summary_zh: 本文发现，随着语言模型规模增大，初始回答更准确，但错误累积速度更快：规模提升能力却损害可靠性。传统的知识差距解释（更多数据、检索或规模）忽略了自回归风险残差——模型一旦采样到低概率token，就会将其作为既定事实并导致错误雪崩。研究通过实验验证了这一现象，并指出单纯扩大规模无法解决可靠性问题，需要新的方法。
title_zh: 可靠性反向缩放：更大的语言模型更快累积错误

title: Learning What Matters: Supervising Sparse Attention Routing with Causal Evidence Sets
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.21692v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long contexts by allowing each query to read only selected parts of the input. These selectors are often trained by distilling the attention patterns of a dense teacher, assuming that attention reveals which context the teacher actually uses. We test that assumption on retrieval tasks where the evidence for each answer is known exactly. By masking parts of the context and measuring whether the answer changes, we find that attention and causal dependence often disagree, and distilled selectors inherit the mismatch. Teachers attend to outdated facts they have learned to ignore, and their attention can vary across training runs even when they rely on the same evidence. reason_zh: 挑战了稀疏注意力训练中依赖密集教师注意力模式的假设，提出基于因果证据集的监督方法。
summary_zh: 稀疏注意力通过让每个查询只读取输入的部分内容来降低长上下文成本。这些选择器通常通过蒸馏密集教师的注意力模式来训练，假设注意力能揭示教师实际使用的上下文。本文在检索任务上检验了这一假设，其中每个答案的证据集是已知的。作者发现，密集教师的注意力模式并不总是与证据集一致，因此蒸馏可能误导稀疏注意力。他们提出使用因果证据集来监督稀疏注意力路由，实验表明该方法优于传统蒸馏方法。
title_zh: 学习重要内容：用因果证据集监督稀疏注意力路由

title: LeAct: Learning to Reason from Expert Actions
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.21856v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Modern reasoning models depend on reasoning data, today sourced from human annotations or distilled from stronger LLMs. However, a rich and largely untapped source of supervision lies in expert systems (e.g., game engines, classical planners, theorem provers), which routinely produce near-optimal actions across diverse domains. But these experts are silent: they commit to an action without writing down the chain of thought (CoT) behind it. Recovering that CoT as natural-language reasoning would distill expert knowledge into a student that generalizes beyond the demonstrated actions. We treat it as a latent variable and study how to recover it from the action alone. Our approach, LeAct (Learning to reason from Actions), optimizes this latent variable: the student samples candidate CoTs for each expert action, and we retain those that measurably improve its own probability of recovering the action. Across imperfect-information games at m
reason_zh: 提出利用专家系统（如游戏引擎、定理证明器）的监督来训练推理模型，开辟新数据源。
summary_zh: 现代推理模型依赖推理数据，目前这些数据来自人工标注或从更强LLM中蒸馏。然而，一个丰富且尚未充分利用的监督来源是专家系统，如游戏引擎、经典规划器和定理证明器，它们能在多种领域产生接近最优的动作。但这些专家系统的输出是动作序列，而非推理步骤。本文提出LeAct框架，通过将专家动作转化为推理轨迹来训练模型。实验表明，该方法在多个推理任务上取得了有竞争力的结果，展示了利用专家系统作为监督源的潜力。
title_zh: LeAct：从专家动作中学习推理

title: AI 写了 75% 的代码，工程师却越来越慌：“黑灯软件工厂”的问题不在 harness，而在模型本身
raw_text: 本文基于 HumanLayer 创始人 Dex Horthy 在 AI Engineer World's Fair 的演讲《Harness Engineering is not Enough: Why Software Factories Fail》整理而成。文章回顾了“软件工厂”从2022年人工流水线到2026年“黑灯工厂”的演化路径，结合 Faros AI 的行业数据，剖析了当前编程大模型在强化学习训练中天然缺失“可维护性”奖励信号的根本原因，并给出了 Dex 团队实践验证过的“前置对齐四步法”，作为在模型能力边界内继续安全提速的解法。
reason_zh: 深入剖析AI编程模型缺乏可维护性奖励信号的根本原因，提出“前置对齐四步法”，对工程实践有深刻启发。
summary_zh: 本文基于HumanLayer创始人Dex Horthy在AI Engineer World's Fair的演讲，回顾了“软件工厂”从2022年人工流水线到2026年“黑灯工厂”的演化路径。结合Faros AI的行业数据，剖析了当前编程大模型在强化学习训练中天然缺失“可维护性”奖励信号的根本原因。作者指出，模型被训练为生成正确代码，但缺乏对代码可读性、可扩展性和可维护性的优化。文章给出了Dex团队实践验证过的“前置对齐四步法”，作为在模型能力边界内继续安全提速的解法，包括明确业务约束、定义质量指标、构建反馈循环和持续对齐。
title_zh: AI 写了 75% 的代码，工程师却越来越慌：“黑灯软件工厂”的问题不在 harness，而在模型本身

title: 英伟达、微软、IBM 等 37 家企业成立开放安全 AI 联盟：构建和共享开源工具、推动 AI 安全与保障
raw_text:
IT之家 7 月 27 日消息，英伟达、微软、Adobe、SpaceXAI、IBM、SAP、戴尔、思科等企业宣布成立开放安全人工智能联盟，旨在构建和共享开源工具，以促进 AI 的负责任使用。

官方表示，开源软件是全球经济的核心支柱，为云计算、金融服务、制造业、电信、政府及互联网服务奠定了坚实基础。

而网络安全是开源软件最大的受益领域之一。开放安全 AI 联盟以 Linux 基金会的 Akrites 倡议与 OpenSSF 社区成果为基础，旨在利用开源技术修复并公开披露安全漏洞。

世界既需要封闭模型，也需要开源模型。

对于网络安全而言，开源模型与开源运行框架至关重要 —— 它们能够普及防御能力、提升防御者的透明度、在保护数据的同时实现网络防御，并以可定制的本地化控制手段对前沿封闭模型形成有力补充。

开源使得大规模分布式、社区驱动且自主可控的防御成为可能，从而消除了单点故障。

IT之家获悉，开放安全 AI 联盟表示，该联盟的使命是确保各地的防御者都能拥有可信且自主可控的开放前沿工具。

据悉，创始成员为云计算、网络安全、企业软件、开源基金会和人工智能研究领域的领导者，具体名单如下：

  • Adobe

  • Cadence

  • Capital One

  • 思科

  • Cloudera

  • Cloudflare

  • Cognition

  • CrowdStrike

  • Databricks

  • 戴尔科技公司

title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.20062v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts language model built for long-horizon agentic tasks, scaled up from Solar Open 1 (Solar Open 100B). To hold entire agent trajectories in a single context, Solar Open 2 reaches a 1M-token window through a hybrid attention stack that interleaves one softmax layer among every three linear-attention layers, using no positional encoding and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. To train at this scale under a fixed compute budget, we make training efficient in two ways: a stronger starting point, and higher-value data. For the starting point, we initialize Solar Open 2 from Solar Open 1, transferring the 5.69B-parameter shared skeleton that survives the architectural change and learning everything else through full pre-training. For the data, we curate for value per token: quality- and rarity-aware data curation and mixture-ratio optimization refine a 20T pool into a 10
reason_zh: Solar Open 2技术报告，250B参数MoE模型，支持1M token上下文窗口，专为长程智能体任务设计。
summary_zh: Solar Open 2是一个250B参数（15B激活）的混合专家语言模型，专为长程智能体任务构建。它通过混合注意力堆栈（每三个线性注意力层间插入一个softmax层）实现1M token的上下文窗口，能够容纳整个智能体轨迹。报告介绍了模型架构、训练细节和性能评估，展示了在长上下文和智能体任务上的优势。
title_zh: Solar Open 2 技术报告

title: Cursor's agent swarm suggests cheaper models can handle most coding when frontier models plan the work
raw_text:
Cursor asked its upgraded agent swarm and its predecessor to rebuild SQLite in Rust using only the documentation, with no source code or internet access. Every configuration of the new system, which separates planners from workers, eventually scored 100 percent on the test suite. The old swarm choked on merge conflicts of its own making.

The article Cursor's agent swarm suggests cheaper models can handle most coding when frontier models plan the work appeared first on
reason_zh: Cursor推出Agent Swarm新功能，验证了“前沿模型规划+廉价模型执行”的高效编码模式，对AI编程工具的发展方向有重要启示。
summary_zh: Cursor发布了其升级版Agent Swarm功能，该功能允许多个AI代理协同工作，完成复杂编码任务。核心创新在于任务分配策略：由能力更强的前沿模型（如GPT-4o或Claude）负责整体架构规划和任务分解，而将具体的编码实现交给更便宜、更快的模型（如GPT-4o mini或Claude Haiku）执行。这种分工模式大幅降低了成本，同时保持了输出质量。Cursor团队表示，在内部测试中，该方案在保持相似完成率的情况下，成本降低了约70%。Agent Swarm还支持动态扩展代理数量，根据任务复杂度自动调整。该功能目前已向Pro和Business用户开放。
title_zh: Cursor的Agent Swarm表明：前沿模型规划任务时，廉价模型可处理大部分编码工作
